Steam To Get Its First Adults-Only Rated Game
At first I thought this is going to be a sex related game. Silly me. That would be inappropriate. It's about brutally massacring innocent people.
I thought the same. Killing people is OK but sex is taboob.
The game is about brutally murdering people, but when you play online don't say anything offensive or you will get banned for life.

I wouldn't doubt seeing this get pulled from Steam now. It was pulled and re-added to greenlight simply because it was controversial. Now that it's officially rated AO there's really no controversy in removing it now.

That would be incredibly unfair on the developers to make a game that doesn't get released on any platform despite being greenlighted by Steam. Not to mention the recent drama surrounding Steam, they could lose a lot of customers if they pull it now. It is unlikely I would play it anyway but I imagine there would be uproar if it were removed.
Gaben personally reinstated it. There's no rule against AO-rated games, in fact there's no rules at all regarding this sort of thing.
PC gaming > consoles. But we knew this. :)
About time. I wonder the average age of steam users is. We can stop pretending like only kids play games now.

My thoughts exactly. While this isnt the kind of AO game that I would like to see (personally, I would prefer to see games to deal with violence and sexuality in honest and down to earth manner, instead of this kind of exploitative thing) but I still am glad that the makers of the games have guts to push this one through. I hope that slow by slow the AO rating wont be the huge stigma it has thus far been and that we can see games that are actually aimed at adults only, instead of some haphazard compromise.

Is Gaben retiring and leaving important decisions to some lower group of bureaucrats? Are they too busy with CS3 or something? Steam can choose to sell whatever they want, and probably realize this game with rake in serious dough because of the controversy like GTAIII did ten years ago. Obviously money is on their fucking mind with the mod cash grab backfiring. This game looks like some conspirio mind fuck for youth devised by a foreign power, but that's just my fedora tipping.

Well... I care :(

It's nice to see de facto censorship circumvented!
I don't know if it's censorship so much as keeping garbage off the platform. The few AO games I've played were awful. They were there for shock value and clearly not anything meaningful.

Since when did games have to be meaningful? I thought most people played games to have fun.

Holy shit, I never noticed! Thanks for letting me know!

The game looks childishly macabre, playing the straight faced edgy card as hard as it will go. It's like a teenager listening to screamo and thinking he's tough. That said getting AO games on steam is a good thing, games like any media can hit some hard subjects from time to time and given videogames' interactivity it can get quite intense.

I'd argue there's a good number of games already on steam that, while they could be played by 12 year olds at times, could only be understood by adults who have gone through a bit more emotional growth and at times really stick with you. I'd like to see more developers reaching for these experiences without the need to obscurify the gameplay or the narrative to make it fit a lower rating than the actual subject matter would entail.
